comment: mon.c newcham() 5300-5306: a debug Valkyrie at experience level 30 creates a chameleon (it appears as a stalker), zaps a wished wand of cancellation at it, which returns it to chameleon form with cham cleared and mcan set, then zaps a wand of polymorph at it until it fails to resist. newcham() sees a cancelled monster with no cham whose base form is a shapechanger, restores cham and uncancels it ('The chameleon turns into an ogre!').
